subject: Ephemeral launch headroom & contract amendment request
messages:
From: Nikhil Raina <nikhil@averysys.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary headroom for launch week (Apr 18-24)

Hi Kimberly,

Quick ask — we have a hard launch scheduled for April 18 that will spike inference traffic for user onboarding flows. Based on our projections we need ~3x our committed QPS for a 7-day window (Apr 18–24). Can Redwood provision ephemeral headroom for that window?

Two specific asks:
- Can you provide pricing options (short-window surcharge vs temporary commit)?
- Can you waive overrun penalties for the launch week and reconcile at list price or provide a one-time launch credit?

I attached a short launch plan so you can see traffic S-curves and major cutover timing. We need a written confirmation to share internally with finance/procurement by next Tuesday so they can approve the PO.

Thanks —
Nikhil
Sr. Platform Ops, Avery Systems
Attachment: avery_launch_plan.pdf
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Nikhil Raina <nikhil@averysys.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-02T11:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary headroom for launch week (Apr 18-24)

Hi Nikhil — thanks for the details and the plan. Looping Ben (pricing) and Laura (procurement ops) so we can put a concrete proposal together.

High level options we commonly offer for short, predictable spikes:
1) Ephemeral headroom (7-day): 30% surcharge on top of committed per-token rate; automatic teardown after window. No SLA change.
2) Short-term uplift commit (30-day min): add temporary committed capacity at a blended rate (approx -10% off list during the uplift window). Better unit economics if you want to keep the uplift longer.
3) True-up with launch credit: we can reconcile actual overrun at list price but provide one-time launch credit (we've done a 15–25% launch credit historically) if you sign an amendment confirming the window and share telemetry.

Ben / Laura — please advise what we can offer from a legal/billing perspective. Nikhil, if you prefer I can draft an amendment (DocuSign) that spells out the headroom window, cap, and reconciliation terms for procurement.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, Nikhil Raina <nikhil@averysys.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-03T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary headroom for launch week (Apr 18-24)

Thanks Kim. Nikhil — quick follow: two pragmatic paths we recommend given the launch profile you shared. I'm attaching a provisional rate card for clarity.

Option A — Ephemeral headroom (fastest to approve):
- 7-day activation window (start date pinned in amendment)
- 30% surcharge on top of your committed token rate for any consumption above current commit
- We will provide a one-time launch credit up to $15k (applies to overrun reconciliation) if you share daily telemetry and post-launch retro.
- No change to SLA.

Option B — Temporary uplift (better economics if usage sustains):
- Minimum 30-day uplift commit for X extra QPS; blended rate = committed rate * 0.90 for tokens used during uplift
- Prorated billing and standard true-up at month end

Operational guardrail: we can cap the payable overrun reconciliation to 2x of your committed monthly spend as long as we receive the PO by Apr 10. This avoids indefinite open-ended exposure for you.

If procurement needs written language I can draft the amendment; Laura can confirm PO timing and DocuSign flow.

Attachment: provisional_rate_card.xlsx

- Ben Carter
Sr. Pricing Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Nikhil Raina <nikhil@averysys.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-04T14:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary headroom for launch week (Apr 18-24)

Kimberly / Ben,

Appreciate the swift options. Procurement will not sign anything that looks like an open-ended surcharge. Two asks from our side:
1) Can you convert Option A into a capped overrun reconciliation where the maximum payable for the window = list-price overrun minus a one-time launch credit (we can accept up to 20% credit)?
2) We need the amendment to state explicitly that there will be no penalties beyond the capped reconciliation and that the headroom will be auto-teardown at the end of the window.

If you can provide a short amendment (1 page) with those bullets we can get PO approval by Apr 10. Otherwise we may need to take the conservative route and throttle.

Thanks —
Nikhil
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Nikhil Raina <nikhil@averysys.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-08T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary headroom for launch week (Apr 18-24) — amendment + next steps

Nikhil — thanks, we can do that. Finalized terms below and attached draft amendment for signature.

Agreed terms (summary):
- Activation window: 2028-04-18T00:00:00Z through 2028-04-24T23:59:59Z (auto-teardown at window end).
- Cap on payable overrun for the window: actual overrun billed at list price, with a one-time launch credit equal to 20% of the billed overrun (resulting net payable = 80% of overrun).
- Maximum exposure cap: payable overrun not to exceed 2x your committed monthly spend (safeguard in case telemetry differs materially).
- Billing mechanics: we will invoice the overrun on the next monthly invoice; credit applied as a line item.
- No additional penalties or SLA changes for the window.

Attachments: launch_week_amendment_draft.pdf (1-page amendment)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/launch-amendment-84721

Next steps:
1) Nikhil — confirm PO path and target sign-by date (you mentioned Apr 10).
2) Laura — please provision the temporary headroom start once we receive signed amendment and PO; route to infra for pre-warm.
3) Ben — please confirm final SKU and how the credit will appear on the invoice.

If that looks good I'll send the DocuSign envelope this evening.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
